title: Hunts FH-047T: Sign-off, sponsor billing and live acceptance run for the sponsor milestone

source.ref: Split from FH-047S (2026-11-16): the freeze, the once-only settlement and the payment sync shipped dark; what an agent cannot do moved here.

detail: Requires FH-045 (the D8 beneficiary and sponsor model, a human legal and finance sign-off that is not given) and FH-047S. Owed by Legal and finance, then Finance and game systems: (1) D8 must say who bills the sponsor and which payee receives the money; FH-047S records what is owed and what the provider says was paid, and creates no provider invoice. (2) After that, a staff screen that writes and approves hunt_sponsor_agreements (today a row can only be written by hand) and issues the provider invoice carrying metadata hunt_sponsor_settlement_id, the key the payment sync matches. (3) Run completion: FH-047S counts a run in state completed, and no shipped code path sets that state yet, so the reader returns no qualification until it does; when it lands, call settleSponsorMilestone from it as well as from the cron, because a milestone reached and not frozen before the Trail ends is owed nothing. (4) One acceptance run against the payment provider in test mode with HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED on in a preview: threshold reached, a replayed event, a reversal after the freeze, an invoice paid, each checked against hunt_sponsor_snapshots, hunt_sponsor_settlements and the lines on the play page, recorded in docs/hunts/SPONSOR-ACCEPTANCE.md. FH-047S proved these only against a fake client. Production switches stay OFF until this passes.
